lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of high-luminance circular nodes arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows posterior to the branchial slits, forming a non-linear grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot lines, creating a geometric lattice structure on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense field of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots on the dorsal head region anterior to the first gill slit; presence of small commensal fish near the pectoral fin base.
